item.title: Black Press Announces Corporate Restructuring and Sale Transaction

item.title: Black Family Announces David Black’s Retirement from Black Press
item.description: The Black Family today (Jan. 15, 2024) announced that David Black, president and majority owner of Black Press, is retiring after a long and distinguished career leading the company. item.title: Black Press Media concludes transition of ownership
item.description: Hyperlocal news network Black Press Media completed its sale Monday (March 25), following the formerly announced corporate restructuring. The sale comes as the company wraps up its creditor protection process in the B.C. Supreme Court and its related U.S. proceedings. The company will remain Canadian-controlled, with its head office based in Surrey, British Columbia. The […]
